decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered Design & Access Statement Received 03/09/2010, Noise Impact Assessment dated 17th January 2011 Received 21/02/2011 and 200/PA/21 Rev: D, 200/PA/63 Rev: E Received 11/03/2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing.

(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.

(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm o Mondays to Fridays, 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays, with no work to take place on Sundays and Bank Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority. No development shall take place until a Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. 

Information on Construction Logistics Plans is available at: http://www.tfl.gov.uk/businessandpartners/freight/11422.aspx.

Condition : 5 - The floodlighting of the tennis courts hereby approved shall not be used except between 10:00am to 10:00pm on Monday to Saturday, and 10:00am to 6:00pm on Sundays and Public Holidays, with the lights to be switched off automatically outside these times.
Condition : 6 - No amplified music shall be played and no other amplified noise (announcements/ tannoy) shall be made outside of the building.
description: Revised proposal for consented outdoor tennis and multi game courts including the erection of fencing between courts to allow five-a-side football
